lines.zh: 我一步跨过荒地的裂缝。
lines.en: My stride crosses a rift in the waste.

lines.zh: 铁靴压弯了细长的骨草。
lines.en: Iron boots bend the thin bone grass.
I walk slowly toward the horizon.
Dust curls up behind my feet.
My armor grinds against itself.
I lift a hand and set my pauldron straight.
I round an end stone pillar.
My footfalls are low and heavy.
My shadow stretches endlessly.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地留下一圈裂纹。
lines.en: Cracks ring where I step.
Step by heavy step, I walk toward the sound.
I pause, then take another step.
I stand like a stone statue.
Violet mist drifts past me.

lines.zh: 我的头盔里没有呼吸声。
lines.en: No breath echoes in my helm.
I rest my hand on the hilt.
I watch the End's sky.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲上有一道旧痕。
lines.en: An old scar marks my pauldron.
I hold still for a long time.
Fine dust falls from the isles.
I listen to wind through the rifts.
I turn my head slowly aside.
My cloak trails to the ground.
I wait for a challenger.
This waste has no master.
Nor will I name one.
You wear ordinary iron.
You walk as if shivering.
I've waited here a long while.
Your weapon is too small.

lines.zh: 这片荒地不容活人久留。
lines.en: The living don't linger here.
No need to hurry away.
I can tell you aren't ready.

lines.zh: 我的剑不伤人，可护甲很厚。
lines.en: My blade spares you; my armor doesn't.
Only wind separates us.
Raise what you carry.
I don't mock the weak.
I'll simply make you stay.
Your eyes are hunting an exit.
This road ends here, no door.
This armour of mine is colder than iron.
Cold air seeps from the seams.
There is nothing beneath the armor.
Your weapon rings on my breastplate.
I retreated. One step.
You endure more than you look.
My sword is still raised.
Nothing can be heard inside.
I'll remember that angle.
Swing once more.
I don't eat mortal food.
Put it away.

lines.zh: 我的盔甲下面什么也没有。
lines.en: There's nothing under this armor.
What would you trade that for?
That cannot pass my visor.

lines.zh: 末地荒地的高个，盔甲十四点。
lines.en: A tall End waste knight, fourteen armor.
Keep it for the rest of your road.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只守着这道门。
lines.en: I eat nothing; I only keep this gate.
Don't wave it before my eyes.
I owe you nothing.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的护膝，弹开了。
lines.en: You hit my knee guard and bounced off.
I don't give half a step.
Are your bones still whole?
You're bounced back a step.
My armor is very cold.
Don't press against my sword.
Four blocks tall; you cannot push me.
You stepped on my trailing cloak.
I look down; there are no eyes in my visor.
Move. I won't say it twice.
I'm no living thing any longer.
There is no heart in this armor.
You should seek the living.
I know nothing of that.
My years outlast this waste.
Such things mean nothing to me.
Do not come closer; I take no mate.
I only keep this waste.
Don't waste your time here.
You haven't much time.
This ingot is still warm.
I bend, my plates clatter.
What isn't mine, I leave.
This belonged to the fallen.

lines.zh: 四格高的我，站在末地荒地。
lines.en: Four blocks tall on the End barrens.
End things are worth little.
I will take this steel ingot.
This isn't my spoils.
I didn't touch what you dropped.
Take what fell; it is yours.
You've come close enough.
I raise my sword.
My shadow already covers you.
No wind speaks for me here.
You've entered my reach.
No haste; I move slowly.
But I never stop.
Your hand seeks your hip.
Begin, and let the waste witness.

lines.zh: 我不会给你第二次，末地荒地的沙很薄。
lines.en: I will not give you a second chance; the End waste sand is thin.
Stand still; do not make me look down.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走向地平线，尘埃卷起。
lines.en: I walk slowly toward the horizon, dust rising.
Each strike takes one step.
You retreat faster than my blade.
But this waste has no end.
My sword is very heavy.
I shift my weight to the front foot.
Fine cracks spread under me.
You can hear my armor.
That is your only cue.
You're waiting for a gap.
I leave none.
I count three steps.

lines.zh: 三步之后你就退不及了。
lines.en: After three you can't retreat.
Two left.
My blade falls and the ground splits first.
A shockwave pushes from my blade's tip.
Your shield is blasted far away.
I raise the tip to your throat.
It's very quiet in my helm.
You fall back two steps, gasping.
I carry no close damage.
Yet I never come empty-handed.
My blade falls, and dust rises first.
I stamp and the end stone splits.

lines.zh: 四格高的末地骑士，步子很沉。
lines.en: A four-block End knight, heavy of step.
Not finished.
A shape rises on the waste.

lines.zh: 我从末地石的影里走出来。
lines.en: I step from an end stone's shadow.
Dust coats my armor.
The ground dips where I land.
I lift my head, empty sockets.
Wind pulls my cloak wide.
I close my grip on the sword.
I keep this place.
Few living things come here.
You came. Good.

lines.zh: 铁靴落地，荒地多了一道影。
lines.en: My iron boot lands and the wasteland gains a shadow.
Don't keep me waiting long.

lines.zh: 我看你这样，就知道结果。
lines.en: One look at you and I know the outcome.

lines.zh: 火焰贴着甲片，我无动于衷。
lines.en: Flame clings to my plate. I don't care.

lines.zh: 我从浮岛坠下，甲片散响。
lines.en: I fall from the isle, plates ringing.

lines.zh: 水淹过盔甲，声音都闷住了。
lines.en: Water closes over me, all sound muffled.
The blast throws me clear of the rift.

lines.zh: 这东西卡进了我的甲缝。
lines.en: That jammed into my armor seam.

lines.zh: 咒力在我的甲片上跳动。
lines.en: Magic skitters over my plates.
Hunger means nothing to armor.

lines.zh: 雷落在我剑上，光沿着刃走。
lines.en: Lightning hits my blade, light running its edge.
In the void, not even the waste remains.
